live_sos_current_coverage.interpretation: This percentage measures how much of the governed English AURN PM2.5/PM10 registry was represented by the live SOS timeseries route in this release. It is not the completeness percentage for the separate England 30-day AURN network review, which dynamically discovers AURN sites and uses official annual hourly UK-AIR files. A live SOS coverage gap blocks an England-wide current assessment from that route; it does not mean the missing stations are inactive or absent from Defra's other official publication routes.

release_gates.claim_boundary: The public website may report verified acquisition, quality screening and explicitly bounded record-linkage results. It may not convert them into source attribution or causal findings.
release_gates.convergence_message: No episode was available for corroboration. Cross-source convergence was not applicable to an episode in this run.
release_gates.environmental_assessment_message: No England-wide current environmental assessment is published because the governed monitoring coverage and freshness gate was not met.

release_gates.public_wording: Acquisition status distinguishes primary monitoring evidence from mandatory contextual sources. A degraded context harvest may support a clearly labelled data-availability release, but not an environmental episode, source, compliance, exposure or health finding. No England-wide current environmental assessment is published because the governed monitoring coverage and freshness gate was not met. No episode was available for corroboration. Cross-source convergence was not applicable to an episode in this run.

blockers: No controlled screening event is available for episode-level cross-reference.
The station-level PM2.5 screen does not satisfy the governed England-wide coverage/freshness gate.
A zero-candidate screen does not establish clean, safe or pollution-free air.

scientific_boundary: This status describes acquisition, validation and evidence-integration readiness. It is not source attribution, a permit-compliance finding, an exposure estimate, a health-risk assessment or a legal determination.
